description: Team chat where AI takes notes, settles disagreements and builds on your machines.
welcome.signedOut:
Sign in to join your team's chat.
[Sign in](command:bria.signIn)
The beta is private: you need an invitation code to create an account.
welcome.noTeams:
You are not part of a team yet.
[Create a team](command:bria.createTeam)
[Join a team](command:bria.joinTeam)
To join a team, ask its lead for an invitation code.
config.notifyMentions: Show a notification when a teammate mentions you or when one of your orders finishes.
welcome.memoryNoProject: Open a project to see its memory.
welcome.memoryEmpty: Nothing noted yet. The server agent records here the decisions, open questions, tasks and compromises from the chat.
welcome.ordersNoProject: Open a project to see its orders.
welcome.ordersEmpty:
No order yet. Ask for a deliverable in the chat: the server agent passes the order to the cook.
The cook works in the folder linked to the project on your machine.
[Link a folder from the Teams view](command:workbench.view.extension.bria)
command.linkFolder: Link a Folder on This Machine
command.setPermissionMode: Choose What the Cook May Do
config.permissionMode: What the cook may do on this machine.
config.permissionMode.manual: You approve each change and each command.
config.permissionMode.autoEdit: Changes are applied directly; you approve each command.
config.permissionMode.auto: Changes and commands run directly, except risky commands.
config.permissionMode.plan: The cook reads and proposes, but changes nothing.
config.lendMachine: Let the cook work on this machine for your teammates' orders when they are not connected.
config.showCookTerminal: Open the cook's terminal automatically when it runs a command on this machine.
config.pushMode: When the cook has saved its work in a commit, on a project with a GitHub repository: push the branch right away, or ask first.
command.updateProject: Get the Latest Version of the Project
command.order.relay: Pass the Order On to Another Machine
